# Retail canonical data dictionary

`retail_facility_month` — **546 columns**, one row per retail customer's ONE facility at ONE month-end.

> **Synthetic Saudi retail demonstration data — not ANB customer data or approved models.** Every threshold, coefficient, bin boundary and distribution in this document is a demonstration assumption. None of it is an ANB policy, a SAMA requirement or a validated model.

*Generated by `scripts/write_retail_docs.py` from the registries the running product reads. Do not edit by hand — edit the code and regenerate.*


## How to read the aggregation column

| Semantics | What it means | How it aggregates |
|---|---|---|
| STOCK | A level at a point in time | Sum within ONE snapshot. Never across months. |
| FLOW | An amount for a period | Sum across the months of the period wanted. |
| RATIO | A quotient | Recompute from summed numerator over summed denominator. Never average a ratio. |
| COUNT | An occurrence count over a window | Read the window in the name. |
| DESCRIPTOR | A label | Count, do not sum. |
| IDENTIFIER | A key | Count distinct. |
| EVENT_DATE | When something happened | Not summable. |
| EVALUATION_LABEL | Forward-looking outcome knowledge | Evaluation only. Never a predictor. |

A column whose grain is CUSTOMER is repeated on each of that customer's facilities. Summing it over facility rows counts one person's income, or one person's obligations, several times over.

## EVALUATION_LABEL (6 columns)

| Column | Business name | Type | Unit | Grain | Products | Aggregation | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `monitoring_eligible_flag` | Monitoring eligible flag | boolean | — | FACILITY | all | none | Whether this row belongs in a forward-default cohort: it is excluded if the facility was already in default at the prediction date. |
| `observed_30plus_within_window` | Observed 30plus within window | boolean | — | FACILITY | all | evaluation only | Whether 30+ DPD was observed in the twelve months after. An EVALUATION label. It became knowable at `outcome_known_at` and must never be used as a predictor or shown as a current fact. **Null policy:** NULL where the window has not fully elapsed and no event was observed. An unobserved non-default is NOT a good. |
| `observed_60plus_within_window` | Observed 60plus within window | boolean | — | FACILITY | all | evaluation only | Whether 60+ DPD was observed in the twelve months after. An EVALUATION label. It became knowable at `outcome_known_at` and must never be used as a predictor or shown as a current fact. **Null policy:** NULL where the window has not fully elapsed and no event was observed. An unobserved non-default is NOT a good. |
| `observed_default_within_window` | Observed default within window | boolean | — | FACILITY | all | evaluation only | Whether a NEW default was observed in the twelve months after this snapshot. An EVALUATION label. It became knowable at `outcome_known_at` and must never be used as a predictor or shown as a current fact. **Null policy:** NULL where the window has not fully elapsed and no event was observed. An unobserved non-default is NOT a good. |
| `outcome_known_at` | Outcome known at | date | — | FACILITY | all | none | The date the twelve-month outcome became knowable. Later than snapshot_date, always. |
| `performance_window_complete_flag` | Performance window complete flag | boolean | — | FACILITY | all | none | Whether all twelve follow-up months fall inside the published history. |
